title: 1.8 What They Are Not Doing
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Say what someone is doing, then what they are not doing, with no before está or están.
grammar_function: Subject + no + está/están + action (no goes before the verb).
prerequisite: Spanish 1.1-1.7: people, family nouns, and está/están + action.
speaking_outcome: Say what someone is and is not doing.
